title: Lab Equipment Scheduling
description: Making shared equipment easier to book. A full-stack platform built for students and researchers.
challenge: Shared equipment needs a reliable reservation system. The platform gives students and researchers a single place to book equipment, while preventing conflicting reservations.
approach: Built a React interface backed by Firebase and Vercel serverless APIs. OTP authentication controls access, while concurrency checks protect equipment and time slots from conflicting bookings. Resend supports the authentication workflow.
result: The platform supports 200+ users. Its focus is a dependable booking flow: authenticated access, clear reservations, and safeguards at the API layer.

title: Genome Analysis Pipeline
description: From raw genomic files to structured features. An automated workflow for analysis and machine learning.
challenge: Processing chromosome datasets involves repeated parsing, filtering, and validation. This project automates those steps so raw FASTA and VCF files can become structured features for analysis.
approach: Developed modular Python processing steps for feature extraction and variant filtering. Added input validation and structured logging to help identify processing failures, and trained models for SNP classification.
result: Automated processing was 50% faster, with 85% SNP classification accuracy. The modular pipeline makes validation and failure diagnosis part of the processing workflow.
